items.title_zh: MOABB 使数据集气泡图可复现（#1168）
items.title_en: MOABB Makes Dataset Bubble Plots Reproducible (#1168)
bullets_zh: 提交 #1168 在六边形受试者布局中用显式 random_state 替换全局 NumPy 随机状态。
固定默认种子使重复生成的数据集气泡图保持一致，同时允许自定义种子。
bullets_en: Commit #1168 replaces global NumPy random state with explicit random_state in hexagonal subject layout.
A fixed default seed makes repeated dataset bubble plots identical while allowing custom seeds.
items.brief: MOABB 改进气泡图随机种子，提升数据集可视化可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB improves bubble plot seeding to make dataset visualizations reproducible.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. items.title_zh: MOABB 在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据（#1169）
items.title_en: MOABB Uses Cached Data Before Prefetching NEMAR (#1169)
bullets_zh: 提交 #1169 在已有缓存数据时避免不必要的 NEMAR 预取。
它在移除缓存后仍保留 NEMAR 优先行为，以确保数据集正确加载。
bullets_en: Commit #1169 avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch when cached data is available.
It preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal for correct dataset loading.
items.brief: MOABB 优化 NEMAR 数据加载，优先使用缓存减少重复预取。
items.brief_en: MOABB optimizes NEMAR loading by using cached data before prefetching.
items.raw_excerpt: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169) * Avoid NEMAR prefetch for cached data * Preserve NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal

bullets_zh: MOABB 预发布版 1.6.1 在代码、引用文件、README 和文档中统一升级版本号。
更新日志将 1.6.1 标记为 Stable - PyPi，并开启 Version 1.7 (Source - GitHub) 开发线。
这有助于用户固定稳定的 EEG/BCI 基准发布版，也便于贡献者跟踪后续变更。
bullets_en: MOABB pre-release 1.6.1 bumps package version across code, citation files, README, and docs.
The changelog marks 1.6.1 as Stable - PyPi and opens Version 1.7 (Source - GitHub) for development.
This helps users pin stable EEG/BCI benchmark releases and contributors track upcoming changes.
items.brief: MOABB 1.6.1预发布更新稳定版与下一开发线，利于EEG/BCI基准复现。
items.brief_en: MOABB 1.6.1 pre-release updates stable and next dev lines, aiding EEG/BCI benchmark reproducibility.
items.raw_excerpt: Pre-release 1.6.1 (#1167) Bump the version to 1.6.1 across moabb/__init__.py, CITATION.cff, README.md and docs/source/cite.rst, and roll the changelog: the 1.6.1 section becomes '(Stable - PyPi)' and a fresh 'Version 1.7 (Source - GitHub)' opens.

items.title_zh: MOABB 从 channel_types 派生 AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels
bullets_zh: MOABB 将 AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels 改为从 channel_types 派生，而非单独存储重复字段。
该修复解决了 147 个目录数据集中 34 个数据集的 n_channels 与 channel_types 不一致问题。
这提升了非侵入式 EEG/BCI 基准流程所依赖的数据集元数据可靠性。
bullets_en: MOABB changes AcquisitionMetadata to derive n_channels from channel_types instead of storing a duplicate field.
The fix resolves inconsistencies where stored n_channels and channel_types disagreed for 34 of 147 catalogued datasets.
This improves reliability of dataset metadata used by non-invasive EEG/BCI benchmark pipelines.
items.brief: MOABB修复通道数元数据不一致，提升EEG/BCI基准数据集可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB fixes channel-count metadata inconsistency to improve reliability of non-invasive EEG/BCI benchmark datasets.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact.
